correctness.rationale: The only congruent pair among frequencies −d,…,d modulo 2d is ±d. All other coefficients are directly extracted by the DFT. Both top coefficients divided by the radius to power d equal a_d times conjugate(a_0), so the two real Nyquist equations have determinant −sin(dα). Equality of the recovered profiles gives identities for the rational quotient under each circle inversion; their composition yields dilation by (R/r)^2, which rules out nonzero finite zeros and poles, then nonconstant monomials. The zero polynomial cannot share data with a nonzero polynomial at >d nodes. At resonance z^d is real at every sample and 1±iz^d coincide in modulus; coincident and collapsed radii give the displayed direct ambiguities. The factor 1/|sin(dα)| describes the normalized top-mode inversion, not the full reconstruction condition number.
